page.overview:
What is Byagoona?

Byagoona the Faceless One is a fictional entity first mentioned by H. P. Lovecraft’s friend and protégé Robert Bloch in his short story "The Grinning Ghoul." It was later expanded on by James Ambuehl and made a Great Old One.

Byagoona is a Great Old One and the offspring of Lu-Kthu. He arrived on Earth during the reign of the Atlaus civilization. During their reign he was revered as a god of the dead and reanimated the deceased to sustain itself on their life force.

After scrying the Eye of Daoloth, Mergowhin of Atlantis claimed that Byagoona later appeared in shadowy Egypt as Nyarlathotep. (: "The Bane of Byagoona") This may mean that Byagoona is in fact one of Nyarlathotep's many avatars, prior to his manifestation in Egypt. This connection is strengthened by the fact that Byagoona is said to have came to Earth "from a world known simply as the World of the Seven Suns".
